defects.description: Incorrect word order and grammar for a section title; should be 'Манифест сессии' instead of a literal word-for-word translation.
Incorrect case inflection; the preposition 'в' (into/in) requires the accusative case 'Фазу' for the feminine noun 'Фаза'.
Grammatical error: 'Не восстанавливаемая' should be written as a single word 'Невосстановимая' when used as an adjective without opposition.
